graph.title: LEGO 7803-1 Jeep
notes: This page is a cover/advertising page with no building step, so no pieces or joins were added. The image shows LEGO Creator set 5891 (house) with 5866 and 5867 alongside. It does not match the Jeep 7803-1 parts list, but I took it as the cover page.
Piece ids will start at b1 on the first page with a building step.
This page has all 9 build steps. All 38 parts are used (b1 to b38). Ids continue from the cover page, which added none.

Each joined edge is one piece listed as 'rests_on' another piece below it. u is the upper piece and v the lower one. Stud and anti-stud ports are left null because the small drawings don't show exactly which studs line up.

Several placements are my best reading of small, ambiguous drawings. I identified the parts by their size and colour against the parts list. The least certain are: the black 4600 wheel holders under the 2x6 chassis in steps 1-2, and the 4x4 plate and two arches in step 3. Also uncertain are the black plates in the centre in step 4, and the 2540 handle plates and 6141 headlights in the front sub-assembly (step 5). Finally, I couldn't tell the red 1x2 plates and 1x1 bricks apart in steps 7-9. The exact 'rests_on' lists for these may differ from the real model.
The wheels (4624) go into the axle-holes of the two 4600 holders, and a tyre (87414) goes on each wheel. The drawing doesn't show which wheel goes in which hole.
